[[File:Galoomps_Digging.jpg|thumb|right|200px|A group of Galoomps digging for desert plums.]]
'''Desert plums''' were a kind of food that grew on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] beneath the sand. They were eaten by [[Galoomp/Legends|galoomps]]. Because they only grew in places where there was a decent amount of water in the soil, moisture farmers would regularly watch for galoomps digging for desert plums, as this indicated there was water in the soil.
